task.title: Build Manager KPI Dashboard Using PropertyMax API

user_message.content:
B
uild a standalone Manager KPI Dashboard web app using the PropertyMax REST API (https://propertymax.ai/rest/max/users/{API_KEY} ). This is being split out from the ApartmentCorp Operations Hub.
The dashboard should include:
A full manager list pulled live from the PropertyMax API, with region filter tabs (All / R1 / R2 / R3 / R4)
Per-manager KPI cards showing: Recent Call Records, Prospects, Guest Cards, Appointments, Leases, Golden Question Score (from task_counts.golden_question_score), and Occupancy %
Color-coded performance indicators (green/amber/red thresholds)
A "Last Updated" timestamp with a manual Refresh button
60-second timeout with auto-retry on failure
A visual loading spinner ("Fetching data from PropertyMax.ai…") while waiting for the API
Exclude Betty Arciba from all results (she is no longer with the company — temporary filter until she is removed from PropertyMax)
The PropertyMax API key is already stored as PROPERTYMAX_API_KEY in the project secrets
Design: corporate navy/white, Inter font, clean admin dashboard style — matching the ApartmentCorp Operations Hub aesthetic.
